facts.fact: The document is the published draft text (avant-projet de loi) of a Cameroon law on the right of access to and use of public information and on the digital transformation of the administration, with chapters on proactive publication, access on request, a Mediator and exceptions; no date is given for the draft, so its published date of 2023-05-22 is used.
facts.system: Avant-projet de loi relative au droit d'accès et d'utilisation relatif à l'information [publique] et à la transformation numérique de l'administration
